features.notes: k6 v2.1.0 exit codes measured, not assumed: thresholds crossed = 99, test.abort() = 108, and a runtime error in the default function = 0. That last one is why lib/metrics.js defines the perf_completed counter with an absolute count>=N threshold: a checks rate threshold does not catch it, because a rate threshold over a metric with no samples evaluates as passing. Also: --no-summary no longer exists in k6 v2 (use --summary-mode disabled).

features.notes: The gate must be safe to mark as a required status check. A workflow triggered only by deployment_status would deadlock any PR that produces no deployment: the required check never reports, so the PR can never merge. Hence the pull_request trigger plus a resolver that exits cleanly when there is nothing to measure. Verified against a real repo: GET /repos/{r}/deployments?sha={sha} then /deployments/{id}/statuses yields .environment_url for vercel[bot] Preview deployments.

features.behavior: The gate can measure routes behind an end-user login (Supabase) by minting a real session and presenting it as the cookie @supabase/ssr expects, and bin/perf-discover probes a running app to report which routes are actually measurable — separating real pages from client-side shells and from redirects to a login.
verification: Round-trip the cookie: k6 encodes it, @supabase/ssr's own decoder reads it back.
Confirm a missing credential aborts with an actionable message, never measures.
Run perf-discover against a real running app and confirm it classifies routes.
Confirm perf-discover flags a client-side shell whose visible text is a loader.

features.notes: Cookie format taken from the installed @supabase/ssr 0.12.4, not from docs: name is sb-<project-ref>-auth-token, value is 'base64-' + base64url(JSON.stringify(session)), and stringToBase64URL emits NO padding — which matches k6's encoding.b64encode(s,'rawurl') exactly. Discovery exists because measuring casabat-comparador-cliente revealed 7 of 9 routes redirect to /login and '/' is a shell whose entire visible text is 'Comparador de Precios — Casabat Cargando…'; measuring it would have produced an excellent p(95) over an empty page.
